page_title: VLL 0-4 SEV | Valladolid v Sevilla 16/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+1' Mamadou Sylla (Valladolid) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Javier Alberola had an easy-decision to make.
90' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
87' One of the players from Valladolid times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
85' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Nemanja Gudelj as he is replaced by Ramon Martinez (Sevilla).
85' A substitution has been made. Dodi Lukebakio is replaced by Peque (Sevilla).
84' 0 - 4 Goal - 0:4! Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) receives a precise pass inside the box from Chidera Ejuke and he beats the goalkeeper with a neat finish into the bottom right corner.
84' Valladolid quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
83' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta has decided to make a change. Suso replaces Ruben Vargas (Sevilla).
82' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta decides to make a substitution. Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) will be replaced by Manuel Bueno Sebastian.
81' Selim Amallah (Valladolid) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
77' Luis Perez (Valladolid) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
75' Here is a change. Isaac Romero is going off and Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta gives the last tactical orders to Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla).
74' Diego Cocca has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Stanko Juric (Valladolid) replacing Mario Martin.
73' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Ruben Vargas (Sevilla), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
72' Anuar (Valladolid) has tested the patience of referee Javier Alberola and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.

67' 0 - 3 GOAL! Superb work from Dodi Lukebakio, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla), who beats Karl Hein with a brilliant shot into the right side of the net. 0:3.

66' Anuar (Valladolid) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the bottom left corner that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance.
65' A wild pass somehow finds Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) in space, he steadies himself and shoots from mid-range but sends it just over the bar.
65' Mario Martin (Valladolid) is penalised for holding. Javier Alberola signals a set piece.
64' Tamas Nikitscher (Valladolid) serves up a nice cross, but Orjan Nyland punches the ball away.
63' Valladolid are ruled offside.
61' Diego Cocca has decided to substitute Juanmi Latasa and he is replaced by Mamadou Sylla (Valladolid).
58' The attendance is 22123.
57' Valladolid have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
55' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) takes a neat pass, dummies a defender and slams the ball well wide of the left post from the edge of the box.
53' Darwin Machis (Valladolid) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box and produces a poor effort that sails miles wide of the right post.
52' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) was quite harsh and Javier Alberola didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
51' Tamas Nikitscher (Valladolid) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
50' Tamas Nikitscher (Valladolid) volleys the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but one of the defenders blocks his shot.
49' Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) commits a foul and Javier Alberola immediately signals a free kick.

49' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Karl Hein pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
46' Half-time substitution. Adam Aznou (Valladolid) will not participate anymore and Darwin Machis is coming on.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Florian Grillitsch (Valladolid) is replaced by Selim Amallah.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) goes into the referee's book. Yellow card.
45+1' 0 - 2 Goal! Isaac Romero (Sevilla) is teed up on the edge of the box by Juanlu Sanchez, and his howitzer of a shot into the top left corner gives the keeper no chance. 0:2.
44' Juanmi Latasa (Valladolid) rises high to meet a perfect cross, but powers his header just wide of the left post.
41' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Anuar (Valladolid) heads on.
39' The resulting corner, taken by Ruben Vargas (Sevilla), comes to nothing.
38' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
38' Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Javier Alberola blows his whistle for a foul.

34' Juanmi Latasa (Valladolid) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant low pass, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem. That should have been a goalscoring opportunity.
31' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
29' Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
29' Looks like Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
26' The resulting corner from Adam Aznou (Valladolid) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
26' The Valladolid players keep hold of the ball by exchanging some long passes. One inaccurate pass, however, surrenders possession. Valladolid get a corner.
25' Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
22' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Sevilla.

20' Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) collects a pin-point pass inside the box and tries a snap shot in the vicinity of the right post, but the goalkeeper dives perfectly to deny him. The ball bounces off his gloves and brushes the post. That was a fantastic reflex save.

12' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Javier Alberola with no other option than to blow for a foul.
10' Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort!

7' Florian Grillitsch (Valladolid) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike to the bottom left corner. Orjan Nyland pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill.

5' 0 - 1 Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) meets a perfect cross from Ruben Vargas deep inside the box and controls it with a nice first touch. He produces an accurate strike into the top right corner. It's 0:1.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Valladolid will take the kick-off.
Javier Alberola will officiate today.
